finding: A partition traversal cannot treat caller-supplied totalCount and paginationComplete values as evidence. Each leaf observation must be bound to its exact request window and commit, retained raw pages, per-page canonical digests, contiguous page numbering, terminal Link state, count agreement, and a canonical receipt digest.

observed_claims: The repository workflow-runs endpoint lists all workflow runs and supports narrowing parameters.
Filtered searches using head_sha or created return at most 1000 results.
Actions read permission is required for private repositories.
REST pagination is represented through Link headers when additional pages exist.

required_bindings: canonical SHA-256 digest for every raw response

verification.claim: The committed contract and deterministic tests are retained; runtime passage is not claimed.

uncertainty: The connector environment did not provide an authenticated checkout for Node test execution.
Receipt validation cannot prove that a caller used authentic credentials or that retained bytes came from GitHub transport without an independently retained transport record.
A totalCount at or above 1000 remains provider_ceiling_ambiguous and cannot be promoted.
Cross-client reconciliation and unfiltered authoritative enumeration remain separate gates.
falsification_route: Run node --test tools/frontier-research/workflow-run-observation-receipt-v1.test.mjs in an authenticated checkout.
Mutate a retained raw response after digesting and confirm response_digest_mismatch.
Insert a cross-commit or duplicate run and confirm rejection.
Leave a terminal next link or omit a page and confirm pagination_incomplete.
Execute authenticated exact-commit retrieval and independently compare the receipt run-ID set against gh api --paginate --slurp and the unfiltered enumerator.
claim_boundary: This artifact defines and tests structural integrity for one retained filtered-window observation. It does not establish provider authenticity, exhaustive repository history, cross-client agreement, deployment identity, route behavior, audio behavior, or physical-device behavior.
